top_revision: After Accept all, show the corrected €74.6m text box on the same slide David flagged, completing the pain-to-solution chain inside her original deck.
retell: Maya needs to update a model, memo and deck for David's scenario, which uses DACH Q4 8.5 and FY26 €74.6m. The chatbot supplies instructions and an unsuitable replacement deck, so she edits her own files by hand and misses another occurrence of the old number. With Agentic Office, one request produces proposed changes across the model, memo and deck, including the missed text box and chart data. She can accept or reject each change, accepts all ten, and the film invites viewers to request early access.
